segments.text: A small electronics company was founded 30 years ago in original city
The founder was a capable engineer, whose commitment was stronger than anyone's
In the first years, the company carried debt
The figures in the accounts were discouraging, and revenue was small
But he convinced investor after investor and raised funds little by little in time
The company rose in the competitive market
It won contracts with overseas clients
And rode the wave of expansion
As chairman, the founder spoke to every employee
But the sincerity of each person
He said today, the company enjoys commercial success
While never forgetting its contribution to the local community
Transparency in management, fairness, and how employees are promoted
The story of this small firm teaches us
That business success cannot be measured by numbers alone
